name: Albany SMR
description: Albany State Marine Reserve is an urban shoreline park at the northern end of McLaughlin Eastshore State Park that protects marine habitat in the eastern San Francisco Bay.
fullDescription: Albany State Marine Reserve is an urban shoreline park at the northern end of McLaughlin Eastshore State Park that protects marine habitat in the eastern San Francisco Bay.
whatTheyOffer:
- Shoreline hiking trails and bay vista points
- Beach area, fishing, and windsurfing
- Nature and wildlife viewing
- Parking and drinking water
- Dogs allowed
- No camping
howToGetIt:
California State Parks does not list a day-use fee for this park.

**Getting there:** From I-80/580, take the Albany/Buchanan St exit and follow the western extension of Buchanan Street to the parking areas.
